Fishery resilience emerges from feedbacks between fish, people, and managers, nested within broader social, ecological, and political contexts.

<!-- TODO: Replace this placeholder with a description of the project's questions, methods, and partners. -->

We are interested in collaboratively developing interdisciplinary research that supports more holistic quantitative risk assessments and equitable management and governance of marine, coastal, and freshwater ecosystems.
